description: Estimates municipal property rates on a South African property from its municipal valuation. Either pick a municipality from the built-in tariff list, or pass the cent-in-the-rand rate and rebate yourself. Call with list_municipalities=true to see which municipalities are covered.

category.description: Rating category: residential, business, agricultural or vacant land. Default residential

list_municipalities.description: True to return the list of covered municipalities and their ids instead of a calculation. Default false

municipal_valuation.description: The property's municipal valuation in rand (from the valuation roll), not the market price

municipality.description: Municipality id from the tariff list, e.g. cape-town

rate_in_rand.description: Override: annual rate per rand of value, e.g. 0.006428

valuation_exclusion.description: Override: rand amount of value exempt from rates

name: municipal_rates
title: Estimate monthly municipal property rates
